text:
pagerduty-bot: PD: high volume of routing errors -> fallback model. alert: ModelRoutingErrorRateHigh svc=runtime count=124 in 5m :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1881234567. Paging oncall (carmen).

carmen: reading into it now. seeing spike across eu-west and us-west pools, not a single host.

mike_sre: looks like routing service  path /v1/infer/routing returning 502 for a subset of model variants. 502s correlate with a surge in queue length.

julia: customer impact? any errors surfaced to customers or just internal fallbacks?

carmen: initial triage: most requests get routed to fallback model (lower-cost variant). Some customers see degradation in quality, not 100% failures, but increased latencies + fallback.

dataviz-ryan: building a quick heatmap to show per-route error rate and severity. dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/team/heatmaps/d/1RtXg (live)

ops-bot: Temporary mitigation options: 1) enable dedupe window in PD to collapse identical alerts, 2) increase grouping key from 'instance' to 'route_id', 3) short squelch for low-severity alerts for 15m.

mike_sre: agree. also want to throttle alerting on noisy metric: model_routing_errors_total. propose: require >50 errors/5m AND >0.5% of traffic for that route.

carmen: doing short handoff: I'll take 10m hands-on run, then hand to mike for deeper config changes.

carmen: applying temporary squelch now to reduce PD noise while we investigate. command: `./oncall tools squelch --alert ModelRoutingErrorRateHigh --duration 15m --note "investigating routing spike"`

pagerduty-bot: Silence applied by carmen for 15m.

julia: can we also set PD dedupe window to 5m for this alert class? Currently dedupe is 1m and we're getting duplicates per route shard.

mike_sre: yes — i'll request change in PD routing rules. Proposed policy: dedupe by fingerprint(route_id, error_type) with window 5m. reduce pages for same route.

dataviz-ryan: heatmap snapshot attached (uploaded): shows concentrated error rate on routes: "search-large-ctx" and "chat-legacy-v2" with spikes in us-west and eu-west.

carmen: initial customer impact: flagged 12 customers with >10% of calls hitting fallback and >15s p95 latency. Not wide outage but high annoyance for those apps. Adding to INC ticket.

mike_sre: root-cause hypothesis: recent routing config push last night changed fallback weight computations; side-effect when backend capacity fluctuates caused over-triggering of fallback path.

julia: plan of record while we validate:
- short-term (now): PD dedupe window -> 5m, grouping -> route_id, apply 15m squelch on noisier not-fully-severe alerts.
- mid-term (1-6h): rollback problematic routing config or gradual revert of weight change, add circuit-breaker threshold.
- follow-up (postmortem): dashboard that surfaces fallback rate by customer, auto-runbook steps for squelch + rollback.

mike_sre: will open change request and coordinate with platform-release to rollback if we confirm config push. tagging release eng.

carmen: doing the PD update request now: `https://pagerduty.redwood/incidents/1881234567/config` (filled fields: dedupe=5m, grouping=route_id).

ops-bot: PD config change queued, awaiting approval from oncall lead.

dataviz-ryan: created temporary Grafana panel: fallback_rate_by_route (5m window) and added to incident dashboard. share: https://grafana.redwood/d-solo/incident/temporary?panelId=7

carmen: quick alert tweak I'm pushing to prometheus to add traffic fraction requirement. alert rule snippet:```yaml
- alert: ModelRoutingErrorRateHigh
  expr: >
    (
      sum(rate(model_routing_errors_total[5m])) by (route_id)
      > 50
    ) and (
      sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (route_id) > 0
      and
      (sum(rate(model_routing_errors_total[5m])) by (route_id) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (route_id)) > 0.005
    )
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
```

mike_sre: LGTM. that should suppress tiny routes with few requests. Make sure we test for high cardinality blowups.

julia: also recommend a long-term change: add an alert that tracks rapid change in fallback_ratio (delta over 5m) so we catch config regressions quickly.

carmen: handoff to mike in 8 minutes. I'll leave the temporary squelch up and note in INC.

mike_sre: picked up. going to engage rel-eng and check last night config commits + rollout windows. opening SRE-4321 to track follow-up alert changes and dashboard dev.

dataviz-ryan: I'll convert temp panels into a shareable incident deck and add an appendix with query examples.

ops-bot: Reminder: update customer-impact field on INC ticket and add list of affected customer IDs.

carmen: updated ticket with affected list + links to dashboards. :white_check_mark:

mike_sre: PD dedupe config approved and applied. grouping changed to route_id. testing behavior now; will monitor for duplicate pages.

pagerduty-bot: PD: dedupe window updated to 5m for alert class ModelRoutingErrorRateHigh.

julia: nice. after dedupe + alert threshold change we should expect a drop in PD noise within 5-10m.

dataviz-ryan: real-time: overall PD pages down 80% in last 6m, heatmap shows remaining hotspots.

mike_sre: starting controlled rollback of last-night routing change on a single region to validate hypothesis. will report status in 20m.

carmen: thanks team. once rollback validated we'll do a coordinated revert and then schedule postmortem + follow-up work: SRE-4321 (alerts & dashboards), PLAT-2112 (routing config guardrails).

mike_sre: confirm: create a permanent dashboard for fallback ratio by customer and a runbook to squelch alerts safely (include PD quiet window recipe). I'll own implementation.

julia: also add a lint/pre-deploy check to catch weight computations that can trigger >2x change in fallback_ratio for top 100 routes.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1881234567: status -> mitigated (temporary measures applied). Please update ticket with timeline.

carmen: closing live incident channel for now, will reopen if rollback fails. good job. :pray:
